sourceText:
Healthier Southern-Style Green Beans
By: Scott Koeneman
Published: Thursday, August 26, 2010 - 8:13pm

Ingredients




2 pounds fresh green beans, lightly steamed
1 tablespoon unsalted butter
1 ounce bacon, chopped (we use the thin sliced Ready Crisp)
1/2 cup onion, chopped

Preparation

1 In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add bacon and butter and render bacon until cooked, but not yet crispy. Add onion and continue to cook until just tender. Add beans and sauté until the beans are tender and heated through.

About


These beans had all the wonderful bacon and onion flavor we were after, retained all their nutrition and one serving was only 90 calories with 4 grams of fat and 5 of fiber. Yum!
